subject: helping you process supplier documents
body:
Hello there,

Saw that 2BROTHER4OLIVESUK LTD supplies olives, pickles, canned products and foodservice packs.

Infratex reads stuff like supplier invoices, purchase orders and delivery notes and can turn them into structured information your finance team can check and use, saving you loads of time.

We could extract product names, quantities and amounts into an AP review table if supplier invoices arrive as PDFs or prepare line-item comparisons and flag differences for an employee before the agreed export if orders or delivery records are available.

We've already worked for a private credit lending firm in Sweden with about $4 billion of AUM and many many other companies around the globe.

Give us 12 minutes next week and we can tailor an entire workflow around your systems in place.

Best regards,
Chinmay
followup_1_body:
Hi there,

The Swedish private credit firm we worked with needed more than extracted text. They needed borrower information organised in their own formats and a way for management to query it.

We built that complete workflow at Infratex. The dashboard, data processing and chatbot were designed around how the firm needed to use the information.

Give us 12 minutes next week and we can tailor an entire workflow around your systems in place.

Cheers,
Chinmay

Hello there,

Saw that at Auquan, your credit agents gather financial and regulatory documents and produce structured credit-analysis reports.

Saw that BASE GROUP SP Z O.O. manufactures industrial equipment and welded structures in small production runs.

Infratex reads stuff like supplier invoices, purchase orders and delivery notes and can turn them into structured information your finance team can check and use, saving you loads of time.

We could extract item references, quantities and unit prices into an AP review table if supplier invoices arrive as PDFs or prepare line-item comparisons and flag differences for an employee before the agreed export if orders or delivery records are available.

We've already worked for a private credit lending firm in Sweden with about $4 billion of AUM and many many other companies around the globe.

Give us 12 minutes next week and we can tailor an entire workflow around your systems in place.

Best regards,
Chinmay

body:
Hey there,

Was looking into Bond Chemicals and saw your work with pharmaceutical raw materials and specialty chemicals. Thought a document workflow around that could be worth testing.

Infratex reads stuff like supplier invoices, purchase orders and delivery notes and can turn them into structured information your finance team can check and use, saving you loads of time.

If these documents are part of your team's workflow, we could structure material properties from supplier specifications if used or extract identifiers from quality documents if received.

We've already worked for a private credit lending firm in Sweden with about $4 billion of AUM and many many other companies around the globe.

Give us 12 minutes next week and we can tailor an entire workflow around your systems in place.

Kind regards,
Chinmay

Hello there,

Saw that CAE Simulation & Solutions Maschinenbau Ingenieurdienstleistungen GmbH provides engineering simulation services including finite-element and fluid-flow analysis.

Give us 12 minutes next week and we can tailor an entire workflow around your systems in place.

Best,

subject: helping you process supplier documents
body:
Hi there,

Saw that FLAIG MAGNETSYSTEME GMBH & CO.KG makes magnetic lifting, clamping and holding systems.

Infratex reads stuff like supplier invoices, purchase orders and delivery notes and can turn them into structured information your finance team can check and use, saving you loads of time.

We could extract item references, quantities and unit prices into an AP review table if supplier invoices arrive as PDFs or prepare line-item comparisons and flag differences for an employee before the agreed export if orders or delivery records are available.

We've already worked for a private credit lending firm in Sweden with about $4 billion of AUM and many many other companies around the globe.

Give us 12 minutes next week and we can tailor an entire workflow around your systems in place.

Thanks,
Chinmay

Hello there,

Hello there,

Hi there,

Saw that PETERS INDU-PRODUKT GMBH makes connectors, cable assemblies and populated circuit boards.

Infratex reads stuff like supplier invoices, purchase orders and delivery notes and can turn them into structured information your finance team can check and use, saving you loads of time.
